name: Skimuseet i Holmenkollen
representationDecision: Create the Ski Museum as a distinct persistent museum institution inside Holmenkollen National Ski Arena. The jump tower remains part of the existing parent arena identity and does not get a separate place marker.

addressConflictDecision.selectedReason: Current visitor-facing VisitOSLO listing and booking location, plus current Holmenkollen.com/Skiforeningen contact information, identify Kongeveien 5 for the Ski Museum.
addressConflictDecision.alternateReason: A Skiforeningen directions page also mentions Kongeveien 40. It is retained transparently as an alternative access/complex address rather than silently ignored.

coordinate.coordNote: Offisiell adressekoordinat fra Geonorge for Kongeveien 5, valgt som Skimuseets besøksmarkør fordi dagens VisitOSLO-oppføring, VisitOSLOs bookinglokasjon og Holmenkollen.com/Skiforeningen-kontaktinformasjon bruker Kongeveien 5. En Skiforeningen-veibeskrivelse nevner også Kongeveien 40; dette punktet ligger 231,8 meter unna og beholdes som dokumentert alternativ adkomst-/anleggsadresse, ikke som canonical museumsanker.

parentOverlapAudit.conclusion: Expected parent/child physical overlap, not identity duplication. The museum is a separate persistent institution with its own collections and visitor identity; the arena remains the broader sports-infrastructure place.

duplicateGate.conclusion: No canonical Ski Museum identity exists on current main.

sourceBasis: VisitOSLO current Holmenkollen Ski Museum & Tower listing — Kongeveien 5 and museum established 1923 / at Holmenkollen since 1951.
VisitOSLO current booking location — Holmenkollen Ski Museum, Kongeveien 5, 0787 Oslo.
Holmenkollen.com / Skiforeningen current contact information — Kongeveien 5.
Skiforeningen directions page — conflicting body reference to Kongeveien 40, retained as alternate access/complex address.
